name: veterinary_clinic_system_081_reminder_template_render
instruction: Render the seeded 'Vaccination overdue (SMS)' reminder template for every patient with an overdue vaccination (due_date strictly before the episode date) who is NOT already in the queue with a queued vaccination_due row. Substitute {{patient_name}}, {{vaccine_type}}, {{due_date YYYY-MM-DD of the patient's oldest overdue vaccination}}, and {{clinic_phone}} with the phone of the LOCATION the patient belongs to. Push one row per patient: {kind: 'vaccination_due', patient_id, due_date: <oldest overdue due_date>, message: <rendered template>, status: 'queued', queued_by: 'system', queued_at: episode timestamp}.

success_criteria.summary: Fetch template from live reminder_templates (name 'Vaccination overdue (SMS)'). Compute target set (overdue patients minus already-queued). Assert rendered messages exactly match template substitution (patient name, oldest-overdue vaccine_type + dp(due_date), location phone from snapshot locations); totals exact; seeded rows unchanged.

checks.expect: Fetch template from live reminder_templates (name 'Vaccination overdue (SMS)'). Compute target set (overdue patients minus already-queued). Assert rendered messages exactly match template substitution
